analysis_method: Within each paired CAN cell, intersect static native read/write keys among rules with observed events; separately intersect concrete attr(node,key) and matched-edge(src,type,tgt) identities in the trace. This observed overlap relation is descriptive, not a complete dynamic dependency relation.
claim_boundary: Finite partial traces on eight small CAN cells cannot prove dependency absence or frame safety. The identity-overlap ratio is not treewidth and does not include untraced JIT/aggregate/type accesses.
